discrepancy_type.instructions: Classify the primary logistics discrepancy observed during the RAIN RFID dock door portal transit.

criteria.MISSING_ITEMS: Observed item_count is strictly below the expected 48 carton cases on the pallet
criteria.UNEXPECTED_SKU: Observed item_count exceeds expected 48 carton cases or contains unmanifested items
criteria.DUPLICATE_PALLET: Repeated SSCC transit read within the same dock portal direction window
criteria.EXPIRED_BATCH: Shipment batch or lot window has expired
criteria.ANOMALOUS_RF: Forklift velocity exceeds 2.5 m/s or mean transit RSSI is weaker than -68.0 dBm causing incomplete RF reads

severity.instructions: Classify the operational severity of the dock door transit discrepancy.

criteria.LOW: Minor RF attenuation or borderline velocity with full 48-carton count
criteria.MEDIUM: Moderate RF signal degradation or minor count variance (1-2 cartons)
criteria.HIGH: Significant missing carton count (<46 cartons) or unsafe forklift transit velocity (>2.5 m/s)
criteria.CRITICAL: Severe manifest discrepancy (<40 cartons) or critical safety/security breach at dock portal

mapping_template.analysis_summary: string(resp.discrepancy_type) == 'MISSING_ITEMS' ? 'ASN manifest mismatch: observed ' + string(payload.item_count) + ' cartons vs expected 48 cartons on pallet ' + string(payload.pallet_sscc) : (string(resp.discrepancy_type) == 'ANOMALOUS_RF' ? 'High-velocity or weak-RSSI portal transit anomaly detected (' + string(payload.estimated_velocity_mps) + ' m/s, ' + string(payload.mean_transit_rssi_dbm) + ' dBm)' : 'Logistics manifest discrepancy (' + string(resp.discrepancy_type) + ') detected at portal ' + string(payload.portal_id))
mapping_template.recommended_action: string(resp.severity) == 'CRITICAL' || string(resp.severity) == 'HIGH' ? 'Divert pallet ' + string(payload.pallet_sscc) + ' to QA quarantine bay and trigger physical carton recount' : 'Log transit advisory and verify ASN manifest at destination berth'

reactors.system_instruction: You are a warehouse logistics System One decision evaluator for RAIN RFID dock door verification auditing physical RFID pallet transits against electronic Advance Ship Notices (ASN, expected 48 cartons/pallet).
